quirks: Full JSON Schema accepted in strict mode INCLUDING minimum/maximum on numbers and additionalProperties:false (verified first try - no schema surgery needed).
gpt-5.x rules still apply: max_completion_tokens (not max_tokens), no temperature; reasoning tokens bill against the same budget (98 on this probe), so keep the 4096 budget generous.

message.content is the raw JSON string; message.refusal is a separate field (null here). Empty content at finish_reason=length means reasoning consumed the budget - map to abstain(parse_failure), never a vote.
Property order in the emitted JSON is alphabetical, not schema order - parse, don't string-match.
The model volunteered abstain=true when it declined - the explicit-abstain path works natively.
